document_support.quote: The military clash called the Battle of Mont Saint-Jean by Napoleon and the French is known as the Battle of Waterloo.
The Battle of Waterloo was fought along the Mont Saint-Jean ridge; Mont Saint-Jean was the French name for that battle.

items.missing_link: No missing link is identified: document 1 explicitly equates the two battle names, and document 3 independently connects them and the ridge.
items.ambiguity: The ridge and battle-name uses of Mont Saint-Jean are distinguished in the text. Both relevant statements identify the same encounter and give no incompatible alternate name.
